localBiteReport: The most recent reports (dating to the week of November 2–9, 2026 — the latest available as of this writing) point to redfish as the dominant and most consistent inshore target around Choctawhatchee Bay. Schools of slot-to-oversized reds have been holding around Destin's bridges, jetties, and the pass, taking a variety of live baits including pinfish, croakers, and herring; a mix of natural baits appears to be working well rather than any single one. Sheepshead are also showing up around bridges and jetties on live shrimp and fiddler crabs, while speckled trout are reported stacking in the deeper bayous and creek systems on the north and east ends of the bay, best targeted with live shrimp or soft plastics. Water temperature at this location is 74°F. These reports are approximately 3–10 days old — the Half Hitch Destin report dated 11-9-26 is confirmed posted but its full content was not retrievable; the substantive bay details above draw from the 11-2-26 Half Hitch report and the Great Days Outdoors NW Florida report covering Oct 30–Nov 5.
